title: Section 190 CrPC — Cognizance of offences by Magistrates (historical)

content.heading: Cognizance of offences by Magistrates
content.text: Historical CrPC provision for taking cognizance upon complaint, upon a police report, or upon information or the Magistrate's own knowledge. After 1 July 2024 the current analogue is BNSS section 210, subject to BNSS section 531 savings.
